carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally along the upper dorsal region, marked by a distinct vertical intensity gradient where the high-luminance dorsal surface meets the shaded lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, mechanical tagging device is anchored to the dorsal ridge, exhibiting localized high-contrast pixel intensity at the point of attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A long, thin, high-luminance linear tether or antenna extends from the dorsal tag assembly diagonally toward the upper-right corner of the frame.
